spanish: y harás pasar toda abertura de vientre a Jehová, y toda abertura de cría de ganado que sea a ti, los machos, a Jehová.

findings.issue: פטר (H6363) is the first offspring that opens the womb or the brood, the concrete firstborn governed by the hiphil. «abertura» names the opening or aperture, so what is caused to pass is no longer that firstborn.

notes: Hiphil 2ms, both כל, רחם, שגר בהמה, אשר יהיה לך, הזכרים, and both ליהוה as Jehová stay in range.
